hints.text: Consider the parity of array length and the cumulative bitwise state before any moves are made.

hints.title: Zero XOR Win Condition
hints.text: If the initial bitwise sum across all numbers is zero, the first player wins immediately.

hints.title: Even Length Invariant
hints.text: When the bitwise sum is non-zero, an even count of elements guarantees the current player can always choose an element whose removal leaves a non-zero sum, ensuring victory.

hints.title: See the blueprint

import functools
import operator
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def xorGame(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        x = functools.reduce(operator.xor, nums)
        return x == 0 or len(nums) % 2 == 0

import functools
import operator
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def xorGame(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        x = functools.reduce(operator.xor, nums)
        return x == 0 or len(nums) % 2 == 0
